properties.description:
Remove predecessor implementations, routes, configuration formats and dependencies in the replaced scope. Verify explicit direct dependencies and correct direction across Broccoli, Btr and Perso; retain no compatibility scaffolding.

Completed: replaced application routes, configuration wrappers, template-specific host knowledge, dependencies and test fixtures were removed or moved to their owners. The 14-workspace composition passes dependency organisation and engine-boundary checks. Existing data was moved to the private repository without replacing repository-owned definitions: 31 sessions and four buildspaces remain available. Temporary cutover tooling is removed after verification.
properties.title: Remove superseded paths and enforce dependency ownership
